Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.p2p

Class P2pNode.Peer

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.p2p.P2pNode.Peer
Enclosing class:
P2pNode
public static final class P2pNode.Peer extends Object
One connected peer: its identity fingerprint, learned nickname, the live SecureChannel and the FileTransferManager bound to it. Peers are created and owned by the P2pNode; the nickname may be updated as presence arrives. Instances are handed to the node P2pNode.Listener.
